settings.question: Do I need power tools?
settings.answer: No. Just basic hand tools — a hacksaw, files, sandpaper, a measuring tape and a work surface (a table around 1200 × 600 mm). Everything else is in the kit.

settings.question: What if I make a mistake?
settings.answer: Most mistakes are fixable. Epoxy can be sanded back and re-applied, and bamboo is forgiving. If you're stuck, our community has seen every problem — someone will have the answer within hours.

settings.question: How strong is bamboo, really?
settings.answer: Bamboo frame tubing tested at Swansea University to BS ISO 22157:2019 — 84.3 MPa ultimate tensile, comparable to mild steel at a fraction of the weight. That figure is for the tubing we supply, not for a finished frame: how strong your bike ends up is decided by your joints. Follow the manual, let the resin cure fully, and check the joints before every early ride — and call us if anything looks wrong.

settings.question: Is it weatherproof?
settings.answer: Yes. Finished frames are sealed with epoxy resin. Dry your bike after wet rides and store it indoors, and with proper care it'll give you years of riding.

settings.question: Not sure which size?
settings.answer: Send us your height and inside-leg measurement and we'll recommend the perfect fit — or choose a Custom frame, made to your measurements.

settings.question: Can I use Cycle to Work?
settings.answer: Yes — build your bamboo bike through the government's Cycle to Work scheme and save hundreds through salary sacrifice.
